title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: opening from the Reports menu starts with no filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations: your current location and your other location.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a vendor with unpaid bills on yesterday's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with the as-of date set to yesterday, only that vendor ticked in the Vendor filter, "61-90 days" ticked in the Past due filter and only your current location ticked in the Location filter.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu).
  2. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") from the Reports menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 2:

  • A/P Unpaid Invoices opens.
  • The filter row reads "As of: " today's date, "Vendor: All vendors", "Past due: Any" and "Location: All locations": nothing was remembered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10a: “Filter choices are not remembered between visits: opening a report from the Reports menu starts on today's as-of date, no customer or vendor, Past due Any, and All locations.”
